findings.highlight: some dorayaki, bean-jam pancakes, that I bought on a whim
findings.evidenceJa: 以前の買い出しの時、気まぐれで買っておいた
findings.governingReading: dorayaki bought on a whim during an earlier shopping trip
findings.explanation: The English removes when Shirou acquired the forgotten food.

findings.evidenceJa: サービス精神にあふれた餡子の量
findings.governingReading: an amount of red-bean paste overflowing with generosity
findings.explanation: The specific generous filling becomes unspecified large portions.

findings.highlight: Sakura really loves the food there
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はここのたい焼きにすごく弱い
findings.governingReading: Sakura has a particular weakness for this shop’s taiyaki
findings.explanation: A precise favorite and comic vulnerability become general approval of everything sold.

findings.evidenceJa: 私は十分余力を残していますが
findings.governingReading: I still have ample capacity left
findings.explanation: Saber’s measured statement that she has room to eat becomes hunger, contradicting her immediate clarification that curiosity rather than appetite motivates her.

findings.highlight: There’s more than enough for you
findings.evidenceJa: セイバー一人で食べきれる量じゃなし
findings.governingReading: it is not an amount Saber can finish by herself
findings.explanation: The English sounds like Saber has been allocated an ample personal portion instead of establishing that the total exceeds what she can eat alone.

findings.highlight: sitting there and staring at the tray
findings.evidenceJa: 座布団に正座してお盆を見据える
findings.governingReading: kneels formally on a cushion and fixes her gaze on the tray
findings.explanation: Saber’s eager but formally composed posture loses both seiza and the cushion.

findings.evidenceJa: しずしずと座布団に正座する
findings.governingReading: decorously kneels in seiza on a cushion
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits Sakura’s formal posture and invents that she sits beside Saber.

findings.highlight: This is certainly more than just dessert
findings.evidenceJa: これは食後の口休めとはいきませんね
findings.governingReading: this will not serve as a palate-rest after the meal
findings.explanation: Saber’s judgment that the rich sweet cannot refresh the palate becomes unexplained praise that it exceeds dessert.

findings.highlight: Sakura reaches out for the dorayaki
findings.evidenceJa: むん、と気合をいれてどら焼きに手を伸ばす桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a determined little brace and reaches for the dorayaki
findings.explanation: A visible burst of comic determination is omitted.

findings.highlight: by the time we finish eating
findings.evidenceJa: 食後の一服を終えた頃
findings.governingReading: by the time the post-meal rest or cup of tea is over
findings.explanation: mirror moon makes recovery coincide with finishing the food and omits the restorative interval afterward.

findings.highlight: It won’t hurt to train until dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 残る半日、夕食までセイバーに稽古をつけてもらうのは無駄ではないだろう
findings.governingReading: having Saber train me for the remaining half day until dinner should not be useless
findings.explanation: The English drops the half-day duration, Saber as instructor, and Shirou’s judgment of practical value.
